description: This file defines the 'RandomGenerator' interface within the Apache Commons Math library. The interface specifies methods for setting seeds, generating random bytes, and producing various types of random values such as int, long, boolean, float, double, and Gaussian-distributed doubles. It is implemented by 'AbstractRandomGenerator'.

classes.name: RandomGenerator
classes.description: Interface for a random number generator, defining methods for seeding and generating various random values.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the underlying random number generator, accepts int, int array, or long.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills the provided byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a random int, either fully or within bounds.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a Gaussian-distributed double with mean 0 and standard deviation 1.
